03Logo

The mark is the Braille character ⠓ (dots 1·2·5 — the H of Hermes) in a 2×3 cell: a monogram in the same grid the product animates its character video with. Panel #161616, 1.5px border, hard offset shadow +6/+6 solid black — never blur, never glow. Cyan cursor lives only in the full lockup. Min height 24px; clear space one dot cell.
